| 37 | PB15 | `HTR_EN` | GPIO | - | out | Heater permit, active high, 10 k ext PD (heater off in reset). The switch input is HTR_EN AND the FPGA HTR_SYNC output: the FPGA applies the requested state (register HTR_CTRL) on a gate boundary, the MCU can remove the permit at any time, and an unconfigured FPGA or an MCU in reset both mean heater off. The actual switch state goes back to the FPGA HTR_STATE input (heater_on_ticks, transition marker). The hardware thermal cut-out is in series and cannot be overridden. |
